scope: Nine production files for the exact-calendar reviews READ vertical and eight associated test sources; read-only static inspection, no test/service/network/PG/HTTP/model/credential execution.

findingsClosed.resolution: Exact-calendar MeasurementRead.reviewScope obtains terminal current membership plus tenant/explicit or inherited branch timezone after awaited entitlement checks. Handler compares initial/current effective branch and timezone to the actual resolved window. Inherited branch id and tenant are checked. Runtime finishes its scoped revalidation with that owner resolver after current policy/principal checks.
findingsClosed.qualification: Current owner Prisma projection; not a serializable SQL transaction, source-version store or new authorization grant.

findingsClosed.resolution: AiCore matches the finite known codes from string, nested error.code or Nest message shape only for 400/409/503. Permission 401/403 and unknown exceptions propagate; source failure is not presented as an empty list.

Saved canonical rating question gates preference carry; period and branch carry independently. Branch survives same-month repetition and month correction. An explicit replaced-but-missing branch becomes unresolved. Old employee constraints/arbitrary clarification do not become a wider query.
Legacy-period exclusion requires a literal string; arrays no longer pass through String coercion into legacy queries.

Verified exact-calendar presentation requires the persisted read turn and C9 COMPLETED; missing/incomplete coordination and final authority failures are refused. Exact review reply does not mint a generic report card.

supportedSourceConclusions: Existing reviews.list.read/business roles/reviews.core and the MeasurementRead ACL owner remain authoritative; no Client/staff expansion, new tool, AE contract, schema, CRM binding or automatic review ingestion.

The exact path supports last_month or named_month, one explicit integer rating 1..5 or all_ratings:true. Mixed rolling/calendar arguments and unsupported/current/future calendar windows refuse. Last_month is resolved into an explicit month before the chat READ and retained rating clarification.

BusinessContent query uses exact tenant/effective branch, rating and half-open [from,to) instants; validates local-calendar boundaries and returned row scope/order; reads limit+1 for has_more and snapshots output before later metadata awaits. Missing/foreign branch, unavailable timezone and query failure are not empty evidence.

The existing execution input hash binds current resolved month, timezone, effective branch and rating scope via readAuthority.sourceScopeHash. The same current authority/scope checks apply to fresh, cached and canonical replay paths. A changed scope does not reuse the old completed result as current.

Reviews are composed by the server, with at most five shown rows, exact boundaries, rating filter, observed source time, explicit has_more and saved-result label on replay. Query projection excludes encrypted text, original review text, identities and arbitrary provider labels; no second model pass receives the review rows.

Persisted clarification_question is restricted to the exact server month/rating question in this response lane and existing encrypted semantic context. It carries preferences only and is reauthorized before READ.

coverageAuthored: Actual CI/parser finite rating clarification and retained month/branch corrections
Owner exact interval/rating/all, observed empty, limit+1, malformed/private row rejection and immutable snapshot
Current membership/user/tenant/branch and timezone changes during awaited work; foreign branch and inherited foreign-tenant branch refusal
Runtime fresh/cache/replay scope binding and policy-await drift
Presenter exact scope, stale/malformed/bounds/privacy controls and C9 missing/incomplete completion refusal
testSourceInspection.status: Inspected test source only; root component/types/lint gates were underway at review time.

limitations: No HTTP/PG/restart/React proof is accepted by this source artifact; the new runner/probe and actual evidence require separate review.
Existing rolling days API remains a legacy path; the exact-calendar source-hash profile does not retroactively qualify all legacy cache behavior.
Current/future months, arbitrary ranges, employee-specific review attribution, ambiguous branch, unchosen/qualitative low ratings and compound scope are not silently satisfied by this finite path.
A local registry query is not proof of an external review provider being configured or exhaustively synchronized. has_more/read count is not a global review total.
No previously scored corpus row or archived result is reclassified by source review, and no model-language/full MAYA/C10 readiness claim is made.
